method.impacts: Exact CCD event pre/post snapshots; observer verified inert
method.reference: Approximate manual centres + grass-patch camera translation; uncertain scale, not a camera solution
method.runner: Diagnostic only: holds 10 m ahead for .12 s, enters at 5 m/s, accelerates at 4.8 m/s² to chosen RUN/SPRINT speed. Catch=lead falls to .5 m after ball overtakes by >1 m. No collider or ball force.
method.tackle: Original aim x=.63 m misses under new turf; re-aimed fixture boot x=.50 m. Old source preserved; both outcomes documented.
